name: motion-exit-fade-shrink
title: Discrete Property Exit
description: Bấm dấu X, thẻ mờ dần, thu nhỏ còn 0.96 và hạ 8 px rồi ẩn hẳn khỏi bố cục; sau đó hiện lại bằng mờ dần ngược lại.

moworks.author: takayu

options.returnAt: s after the start to come back (0.4 s ease-out, no drop; null: stay hidden)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio discrete-exit, written here): Card 140x64 r10 with a close X; click at 0.38 s. Exit over 0.5-0.98 s (480 ms) power2.in: opacity 1 → 0, scale 1 → 0.96, y 0 → +8 px; then hidden (display none, a dashed placeholder shows the empty slot). Demo re-entry at 2.0-2.4 s power2.out: opacity 0 → 1, scale 0.96 → 1, no y move. Params: duration (0.48 s) · scale (0.96) · drop (8 px) · ease (power2.in) · back (0.4 s, power2.out). After the exit the element is display: none (out of the layout), as a discrete property ends a CSS exit.
